run_adsorption_relaxation: run an AdsorptionRunner to relax adsorbate plus surface configurations and compute adsorption energy
calculate_adsorption_chunk: calculate adsorption relaxation results for a specific job chunk using AdsorptionRunner.calculate
write_adsorption_results: write adsorption calculation results to a compressed JSON file using AdsorptionRunner.write_results
init_adsorption_runner: initialize an AdsorptionRunner with an ASE calculator, input data, and relaxation parameters like fmax and steps
review_adsorption_runner_class: review the AdsorptionRunner class and its calculate method for relaxing atomic structures
